description: Panasonic EVQ-P7A01P — 6.0 × 6.0 × 3.5 mm low-profile SMD tactile switch. 100 gf actuation force, 100 000 cycle life, gull-wing leads, exposed metal cap. The premium maker reset/user-button choice — cleaner click and longer life than the dollar-store 6×6 generics. Direct drop-in for many through-hole layouts thanks to the standard 6 mm body footprint.
name: evq-p7a01p
watch_out_for: Four leads in two electrically-shorted pairs: pins 1-2 are internally connected, pins 3-4 are internally connected; the switch closes between the (1,2) and (3,4) pairs when pressed. Don't rely on the package outline alone — the schematic symbol should show that the 1-3/2-4 connection is what toggles. NOT a momentary detect/illumination switch — no LED, no held-down latching. For a cheaper drop-in alternative use XKB TS-1187A-B-A-B (LCSC C318884) with the same 6×6×3.5 mm body. For surface-mounted right-angle, switch to EVP-AA series.
